caption: The video depicts a close-up, slightly top-down view of a hand holding a white paper napkin flat over a gray concrete surface. The upper-right corner of the napkin is already alight when the clip starts, a small orange-yellow flame licking along a brown-to-black charred margin. This flame persists throughout, flickering in shape and brightness. Sometimes it forms a single tongue, sometimes splitting into two. As the burning continues, the charred region gradually enlarges and the paper edge is visibly eaten away, so the burnt hole grows. A second, partly visible clenched hand remains at the top-right edge of the frame the whole time. The holding thumb grips the lower edge of the napkin and shifts slightly, drifting the sheet within the frame. Over the course of the clip the napkin's fold reads differently, with a lifted flap or second layer becoming apparent on the left as the whole sheet tilts. The fire stays anchored at the corner and continues burning through the final frame.
